name: Córus Cerda
text: Córus Cerda is an Irish term sent by the dictionary to the entry imbas forosnai. The cross-reference ties it to the divination system of the Druids. That lore covered hidden things, stolen goods, and secrets kept from common knowledge. Readers should follow the imbas forosnai entry for the rite and its stages.
